ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Acutaas Chemicals Limited has intimated a record date of September 17, 2026, for a proposed final dividend of Rs. 2.50 per equity share for FY 2025-26. This 50% dividend (on a Rs. 5 face value) is contingent upon shareholder approval at the 19th Annual General Meeting on September 24, 2026, with payment expected within 30 days of declaration. This represents a standard corporate action indicating a potential return for eligible shareholders, and the document contains no immediate red flags.
